issue.body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/encode/starlette/discussions/1577
Originally posted by **vbsd** April 7, 2022 It seems that there is a mistake in starlette's WebSocket [status code list](https://github.com/encode/starlette/blob/0.19.0/starlette/status.py#L83). Status code 1005 has the name `1005_ABNORMAL_CLOSURE` and 1006 is missing altogether. However, [Mozilla MDN docs](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/CloseEvent/code) indicate that 1005 actually means "no status received". It is status code 1006 that means "abnormal closure". It looks like what should have been ``` WS_1005_NO_STATUS_RECEIVED = 1005 WS_1006_ABNORMAL_CLOSURE = 1006 ``` got mashed together and became just one line: ``` WS_1006_NO_STATUS_RECEIVED = 1005 ``` Making starlette backwards-incompatible over this wouldn't make much sense, but it seems reasonable to at least add the two correct lines and document `WS_1005_ABNORMAL_CLOSURE` as deprecated/wrong.
issue.title: BUG: Incorrect WebSocket status code 1005 description, missing status code 1006
